statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93247
The patient has recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to assess for paroxysmal arrhythmic events and optimize anticoagulation management
The clinical indication note documents that less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed insufficient
